title.en: QA review of W4-B0 dependency governance (279db5c8 + cc43c2cd, card G): seven W4 entity cards registered correctly (proposed/no checks/ids/write scopes match E1-E7, acceptance references placeholders and forbids direct start); card G 12 checks incl. 7 json status==proposed guards, verified; plan doc 8561 B/fd91bc8f with draft header and B0-1/2/4 pending Chief (not executed), no conclusion wording; commits touch only .normify + docs plan, no code/criteria change; gates 1406/0/402 - PASS with 1 low (slice count 24 vs 25 rows) + 2 observations

intent.zh: 对卡 G（W4-B0 依赖治理与 24 片派工拆分，提交 **`279db5c8`** 内容 + **`cc43c2cd`** 登记，卡 `2026-11-11-w4-b0-dependency-governance`）做独立只读复核（零 GPU）：①7 张实体卡登记是否正确（id/依赖/checks/写域/状态）；②计划文档口径（草案声明、B0 裁决项只列不结论、片数拆分）；③无代码改动、不改判据；④门禁/编码/边界。**只写本卡与本卡证据。**
intent.en: Independent read-only review of card G: correctness of the 7 registered entity cards, plan document wording (draft disclaimer, B0 pending items without conclusions, slice breakdown), no code/criteria change, gates/encoding/boundaries.

acceptance: **7 张实体卡 ✅**：`p8-entry-admission`/`m03-p8-asset-conversion`/`r10-p8-batch-scheduling`/`r10-p10-batch-scheduling`/`m10-p10-rust-callback`/`p8-base-admission`/`p8-admission` 均 `status=proposed`、`checks=[]`、owner Backend、phase P8-渲染与BVH；id/优先级/写域与计划表 **E1–E7 逐项对应**；acceptance 只引用占位卡口径并明写「不新增判据」「当前 checks=[]，禁止直接 start」「不得宣称全部渲染通过/等价」

**卡 G 本身 ✅**：status=verified；12 检查 = 4 门禁 + `unchanged src/ tests/ fixtures/ scripts/` + **7 条 `json …/status == proposed`**（对登记卡的机器守卫）；`schedule.files` 仅 `.normify/changes/` + `docs/development-evidence/plan/`；门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda exit 0、unit **1,406/0/402**

**计划文档 ✅**：`W4-dependency-governance.md` **8,561 B / `fd91bc8fba89d38e691a973e8605a4b8b2f16efb208594122a8e326356b064c9`**（与 Chief 派工值一致）、83 行、UTF-8/LF 无 BOM/CR/NUL；首行「（草案；2026-11-11）」+ 引用块「**草案；裁决项未定，不构成结论**」；B0-1/2/4 状态列均为「**待 Chief 裁决（本卡未执行）**」、B0-3 排后；§5 明写「未执行 B0-1/2/4……只列待裁点，不伪造解除、不写 waived 依据」；结论词 grep：已裁决/已签/已批/已批准/已执行/已解除/已waive/发布通过 全 0，「准入通过」仅 1 处否定句

**边界/编码 ✅**：`git diff 875ae41d..279db5c8` 仅 `.normify`（卡/门禁记录）+ 7 张实体卡 JSON + `docs/development-evidence/plan/W4-dependency-governance.md`；**无** `src/`/`tests/`/`fixtures/`/`scripts/` 改动（两个提交均如此）、guards/冻结件未动、不改判据/参考/容差；零 GPU、零窗

**结论：复核通过（0 阻断，1 低 + 2 观察）。** 低 L1：§3「24 片 = B0 4 + 实体 20」与表内实际 **25 行**（4 + 7×3=21）不一致；观察 O1：实体卡 `depends_on` 空/`checks=[]` 为刻意设计（B0 待裁、不伪造解除，建议裁决后补机器依赖）；观察 O2（正向）：7 条 `json /status==proposed` 守卫值得 H 卡沿用
**口径**：不宣称 P8 准入通过/全部渲染通过/等价/发布；阶段准入 ≠ 发布声明；不改判据/参考/容差；零 GPU
